examples: I just got in the zone late in the game: everything was going in.
wiktionary.gloss: A mental state of high concentration and performance; see: in the zone.
A defensive scheme where defenders guard a particular area of the court or field, as opposed to a particular opposing player.
That collection of a domain's DNS resource records, the domain and its subdomains, that are not delegated to another authority.
A logical group of network devices on AppleTalk (an obsolete networking protocol).
A belt or girdle.
The curved surface of a frustum of a sphere, the portion of surface of a sphere delimited by parallel planes.
A frustum of a sphere.
A circuit; a circumference.

blocks.etymology: From Latin zōna, from Ancient Greek ζώνη (zṓnē, “girdle, belt”). Doublet of zona.

senses.definition: To officially decide that an area of land can only be used for a specific purpose.

examples.en: This district was zoned for industrial development five years ago.
examples.vi: Quận này đã được quy hoạch cho phát triển công nghiệp cách đây năm năm.

senses.vi: quy hoạch vùng; chia thành khu vực

thesaurus.definition: regulate housing in; of certain areas of towns
separate or apportion into sections

vi_block: Chia thành đới, chia thành khu vực, quy vùng.

examples: Please zone off our staging area, a section for each group.
wiktionary.gloss: To divide into or assign to sections or areas.

examples: This area was zoned for industrial use.
wiktionary.gloss: To define the property use classification of (an area).

examples: I must have zoned while he was giving us the directions.
Everyone just put their goddamn heads together and zoned.
wiktionary.gloss: To enter a daydream state temporarily, for instance as a result of boredom, fatigue, or intoxication; to doze off.

examples: We've zoned each other as friends; we'll never be anything more.
wiktionary.gloss: To assign to a restricted category.

idioms.gloss: To classify (someone) as a friend, without any possibility of a romantic relationship.
To fill a relevant region of the field of play.
To put or place into an indeterminate position; to be in an ambiguous, undetermined, or improper context.
In a mental state of focused concentration on the performance of an activity, in which one dissociates oneself from distracting or irrelevant aspects of one's environment.
To classify as a fuck buddy.

phrasal_verbs.gloss: To stop paying attention and think about something else, or to think about nothing

tatoeba.en: Earthquakes often occur at subduction zones.
